name: erp-master
description: ERP Empresarial Profissional, Modular e Seguro com Node.js, Express, Prisma, SQLite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind e Docker/Dockploy

scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
